messages.author: Ville Valokuitu
messages.text: Hi Marja, I'm on TRN-100. Counters here are clean, no CRC errors on our side at all.

messages.author: Marja Mittaaja
messages.text: The customer still sees errors on that link though. Monitoring shows them on the far end, on whatever unit terminates the other side.

messages.author: Marja Mittaaja
messages.text: The circuit record doesn't say, it's blank. I'll ask planning. But when one side is clean and the far side keeps counting CRCs, the fault is normally in that far unit's receive path. Whoever goes there should clean the connector first, then try a new patch lead, and only then think about the optics.

messages.author: Ville Valokuitu
messages.text: Understood. Nothing more for me to do here then.
